objectives.description: Stop driving the loop off .path strings; iterate whole records
Ship divergence check as WARN, not FAIL

approaches_tried.approach: divergence bucket 3 (id-inconsistent) defined as .id != dir_key AND .id not in FTS (literal plan wording)
approaches_tried.reason: Verified by execution against the live corpus that this literal reading flags all 17 of Decision C's explicitly-supported paired entries (curated .id differs from FTS doc_id, resolved via the path bridge) as broken, contradicting Decision C's own statement that this pairing is a supported configuration, not a defect. Redefined to additionally require the dir_key itself to also fail FTS resolution, which correctly excludes the 17 supported pairings while still catching a genuinely unreachable entry (fixture-proven).

deviations.description: Live-corpus divergence bucket 1 (FTS-only, no index coverage) expected to read 15 per the plan's Scope Hypothesis phrasing
deviations.reason: Verified by execution: the live corpus reads 0 for this bucket, not 15. Investigated why -- Phase 2's own design (quoted in this phase's own task list: 'Iterate .entries[]? (children included) -- that is what pulls in the directories whose only index coverage is at child level') means literature-doc-key.sh's --list-keys unions the path-derived key across ALL entries, not just parents. The 15 directories Decision C names ('FTS-only directories with no PARENT entry') already have CHILD-level entries whose .path points into them (confirmed for burgess_1982: child entries burgess_1982_sec01/sec02 carry path sources/burgess_1982/...), so they are already functionally reachable via the bridge search/briefing actually use. Decision C's '15' figure is a Phase-8-scoped browsability/completeness concern (add a parent record so the directory has a proper top-level entry), not a reachability defect this divergence check should flag. The other two buckets match the plan's stated expectation exactly: index-only=1 (gabbay_2000), id-inconsistent=0.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — bucket 1 correctly reads 0 on the live corpus per Phase 2's child-inclusive design, not the plan's 15; see phase notes)*
